correctness.rationale: All quantitative equalities are checked from the K3 intersection form; KV vanishing gives H1(rD)=0 for r>=1 and dual negatives. Kodaira gives H1(mD-2E)=0 m>=2 and H1((m-1)D-2E)=0 for m>=3; for m=2 the restriction sequence for quadrics on E proves H1(2h-E)=0. Its Serre-dual vanishing supplies the exact hypothesis of [1, Proposition 4.7]. [1, Lemmas 2.11--2.12 and 4.1, 4.3, 4.6 and Theorem 1.2] then give the smooth flag, three-dimensional excess tangent space and second-order obstructions. The component dimension also follows by uniqueness of S from quadrics through C and finiteness of lines on S.
